question: Why should offerings and worship be done with the left hand?
premises: Worship includes incense, food, satisfaction, and other offerings.
These may be offered elaborately or concisely.
Samsara follows a leftward course, so all is done with the left hand.
inference: The ritual use of the left hand corresponds to the leftward movement of samsara.
uncertainties: The doctrinal nuance of saṃsāravāmācāratva may carry a technical Tantric sense beyond the literal wording.
plain_english: With incense, food offerings, acts of satisfaction, and so on, worship may be done in elaborate or concise form. Because samsara moves in a leftward way, all of this should be done with the left hand.
